items.title: Bob Rosengarden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 6, 1996
items.q: I got friendly with a lot of the Brazilians — Jobim and Luiz Bonfa.

ctx.x: It’s true. It’s called music. I listen at home, to my wife’s chagrin, I listen to long hair music almost all the time. The only other kind of music I listen to is Brazilian music. I have a soft spot in my head for that. And I got friendly with a lot of the Brazilians — Jobim and Luiz Bonfa. I saw Black Orpheus 37 times, you know, and I said oh my God, what is that, and loved it, and became, I was the only gringo who could imitate that.
Right. And knew the difference between the different Latin styles. I mean it’s one thing to say well play this Latin. Well there’s a lot of —
